name: run_query
description: Execute a read-only SQL statement against the warehouse and return up to `limit` rows. Long-running statements return a job_id instead.

name: explain_query
description: Return the plan and estimated bytes scanned for a SQL statement without executing it.

name: cancel_query
description: Cancel a running job.

name: get_query_status
description: Status (queued/running/done/failed), elapsed time and bytes processed for a submitted job.

name: list_schemas
description: List schemas (datasets) in the warehouse.

params.database: optional database name; defaults to the analytics database

name: list_tables
description: List tables and views in a schema.

params.pattern: optional LIKE pattern on the table name

name: describe_table
description: Column names, types, nullability and column descriptions for a table or view.

name: preview_table
description: First N rows of a table or view, no SQL needed.

name: list_curated_views
description: List the curated business views maintained and documented by the data team (finance.*, marketing.*, product.*). Prefer these over raw tables for reported numbers.

name: get_view_definition
description: SQL definition, owner and last-modified date of a view.

name: marketing_spend_by_channel
description: Aggregate paid media spend by channel and day from the curated marketing.spend_by_channel view. Synced nightly from every ad platform and reconciled with finance; use for reporting.

params.channel: optional channel filter (search, social, display, video)

name: get_revenue_metrics
description: MRR, ARR, net new MRR, expansion and churned MRR from the curated finance.mrr_daily view, for any historical date range.

name: list_saved_reports
description: List saved reports (named, parameterized SQL) the caller can see.

name: run_saved_report
description: Run a saved report by id, optionally overriding its parameters. Returns rows and a job_id.

name: save_report
description: Save a SQL statement as a named report with optional parameters and tags.

name: get_query_history
description: Recent statements run by a user or against a table, with runtime, bytes scanned and status.

name: export_query_results
description: Write the results of a finished job to CSV or Parquet and return a signed download URL valid for 24h.

name: schedule_report
description: Run a saved report on a cron schedule and deliver the results by email or to a chat channel.

name: get_table_freshness
description: Last successful load time and row count for a table, and whether it is past its freshness SLA.

name: search_data_catalog
description: Full-text search over table names, column names and column descriptions in the warehouse catalog.

name: get_column_lineage
description: Upstream sources and downstream dependents of a column, as a lineage graph.

name: list_campaigns
description: List campaigns across all connected ad accounts. Filter by platform, status or name.

name: get_campaign
description: Get one campaign: objective, status, bid strategy, schedule and lifetime results.

name: create_campaign
description: Create a campaign in an ad account. New campaigns are created paused so you can review before launch.

name: pause_campaign
description: Pause a campaign. Ads stop serving within a few minutes.

name: resume_campaign
description: Resume a paused campaign.

name: duplicate_campaign
description: Copy a campaign together with its ad sets and ads. The copy starts paused.

name: list_ad_sets
description: Ad sets (ad groups) under a campaign, with targeting summary, status and bid.

name: update_ad_set_targeting
description: Change who an ad set reaches: locations, age range, interests, placements.

params.targeting: object with locations, age_min, age_max, interests, placements

name: list_ads
description: Individual ads in an ad set with creative preview link and delivery status.

name: get_budget
description: Current daily and lifetime budget for a campaign or ad set, and how much of it remains.

name: set_budget
description: Set the daily or lifetime budget of a campaign or ad set. Takes effect immediately on the platform.

name: get_spend
description: Spend, impressions, clicks and CPC pulled live from the ad platform APIs. Near real-time, not reconciled.

params.campaign_id: optional campaign id; all campaigns if omitted

name: get_conversions
description: Conversions, CPA and ROAS as attributed by the ad platform, per campaign or ad set.

name: get_pacing
description: Month-to-date spend vs planned budget per campaign, with projected end-of-month spend.

name: list_audiences
description: Saved, custom and lookalike audiences with approximate size.

name: create_lookalike_audience
description: Build a lookalike audience from a seed audience.

params.similarity: 1-10, lower is closer to the seed

name: upload_customer_list
description: Upload a file of emails or phone numbers (hashed client-side) to create or refresh a customer-match audience.

name: list_ad_accounts
description: Connected ad accounts with platform, currency and timezone.

name: get_ad_disapprovals
description: Ads rejected or limited by platform policy review, with the stated reason.

name: crm_search_accounts
description: Search company accounts by name, website domain or owner. Returns account ids.

name: crm_get_account
description: Fetch an account record: owner, tier, industry, ARR, renewal date, open deals and primary contacts.

name: crm_update_account
description: Update fields on an account such as owner, tier, industry or renewal date.

name: crm_list_contacts
description: List the people at an account with job title, email, phone and last activity date.

name: crm_get_contact
description: Get a single person by contact id or email address.

name: crm_create_contact
description: Create a person record and optionally link it to an account.

name: crm_list_deals
description: List deals (opportunities) filtered by stage, owner, account or expected close date.

name: crm_get_deal
description: One deal with amount, stage, probability, expected close date and line items.

name: crm_create_deal
description: Open a new deal on an account.

name: crm_update_deal_stage
description: Move a deal to another stage, e.g. Discovery -> Proposal -> Closed Won. Closed Lost requires a reason.

name: crm_get_pipeline_summary
description: Count, total and probability-weighted value of open deals by stage, for a pipeline, owner or quarter.

name: crm_get_forecast
description: Quarter forecast by rep: commit, best case, and closed-won to date.

name: crm_add_note
description: Attach a free-text note to an account, contact or deal.

name: crm_list_notes
description: Notes and logged activities (calls, emails, meetings) on a record, newest first.

name: crm_log_activity
description: Log a call, meeting or email against a record so it shows in the timeline.

name: crm_list_tasks
description: Open follow-up tasks assigned to a rep, optionally due before a date.

name: crm_create_task
description: Create a follow-up task on a record with a due date and assignee.

name: crm_list_renewals
description: Accounts whose contract renews within a date window, with ARR and health score.

name: crm_merge_accounts
description: Merge a duplicate account into a primary one. Contacts, deals and notes move to the primary. Cannot be undone.

name: searchPages
description: Search pages in the workspace by title and body text. Returns page ids, titles and a snippet.

name: getPage
description: Get a page's content as markdown.

name: createPage
description: Create a page under a parent page or at the top of a space.

name: updatePage
description: Replace or append to a page's content.

name: deletePage
description: Move a page and all its children to trash.

name: movePage
description: Move a page under a new parent.

name: listRecentPages
description: Pages the caller edited or viewed recently.

name: getPageHistory
description: Version list for a page with author and timestamp of each edit.

name: restorePageVersion
description: Revert a page to an earlier version from its history.

name: listDatabases
description: List databases (structured collections of pages with properties) in a space.

name: queryDatabase
description: Filter and sort the rows of a database by property values.

name: createDatabaseRow
description: Add a row to a database.

name: updateDatabaseRow
description: Change property values on an existing database row.

name: addComment
description: Comment on a page, or reply in an existing comment thread.

name: listComments
description: Comment threads on a page, open by default.

name: resolveComment
description: Mark a comment thread as resolved.

name: sharePage
description: Share a page with a person or group, or toggle its public link.

name: listTemplates
description: Templates available in the workspace.

name: createPageFromTemplate
description: New page from a template, with template variables filled in.

name: exportPage
description: Export a page, optionally with its children, as PDF, Markdown or HTML.

name: github_search_repos
description: Search repositories in the organization by name, topic or primary language.

params.q: search text, supports topic: and language: qualifiers

name: github_get_file
description: Get the contents of a file in a repository at a branch, tag or commit SHA.

params.ref: branch, tag or SHA; default branch if omitted

name: github_search_code
description: Search code across the organization's repositories.

params.q: search text, supports repo:, path:, language: qualifiers

name: github_list_prs
description: List pull requests in a repository. Filter by state, author, base branch or label.

name: github_get_pr
description: Get a pull request: title, body, author, requested reviewers, review state, mergeability and check status.

name: github_get_pr_diff
description: Get the unified diff of a pull request.

name: github_create_pr
description: Open a pull request from a head branch into a base branch.

name: github_review_pr
description: Submit a review on a pull request: APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES or COMMENT.

name: github_merge_pr
description: Merge a pull request with the merge, squash or rebase method. Fails if required checks or reviews are missing.

name: github_list_issues
description: List issues in a repository, filtered by state, labels or assignee.

name: github_search_issues
description: Search issues and pull requests across the organization using GitHub search syntax.

params.q: search text, e.g. 'is:issue is:open label:bug timeout'

name: github_create_issue
description: Create an issue in a repository.

name: github_comment_issue
description: Add a comment to an issue or pull request.

name: github_close_issue
description: Close an issue as completed or not planned.

name: github_list_workflow_runs
description: List GitHub Actions workflow runs for a repository or branch with status and conclusion.

name: github_get_workflow_run_logs
description: Get the logs of a workflow run, or of one failed job in it.

name: github_rerun_workflow
description: Re-run a workflow run, or only its failed jobs.

name: github_list_releases
description: List releases of a repository with tag, name, date and release notes.

name: github_create_release
description: Create a release from a tag. Can generate release notes from merged pull requests.

name: github_list_commits
description: List commits on a branch, optionally limited to a path, author or date range.

name: github_compare_refs
description: Compare two refs (branches, tags or SHAs): commits and changed files between them.

name: slack_list_channels
description: Lists public and private channels the bot can see, with member count and topic.

name: slack_get_channel_history
description: Fetches recent messages posted in a channel.

name: slack_search_messages
description: Searches messages in every channel and DM the user can access. Supports modifiers like in:#channel, from:@user, before:2026-01-01.

name: slack_post_message
description: Posts a message to a channel.

name: slack_reply_in_thread
description: Replies under an existing message thread.

name: slack_get_thread_replies
description: Gets every reply in a message thread.

name: slack_add_reaction
description: Adds an emoji reaction to a message.

name: slack_pin_message
description: Pins a message to its channel.

name: slack_list_users
description: Lists workspace members with display name, title, timezone and presence.

name: slack_get_user_profile
description: Gets a member's profile: real name, title, email, timezone and status.

name: slack_send_dm
description: Opens a direct message with one or more members and sends text.

name: slack_schedule_message
description: Schedules a message to be posted to a channel later.

name: slack_set_reminder
description: Creates a reminder for the user.

name: slack_list_reminders
description: Lists the user's reminders.

name: slack_create_channel
description: Creates a new channel.

name: slack_invite_to_channel
description: Invites members to a channel.

name: slack_set_channel_topic
description: Sets the topic shown at the top of a channel.

name: slack_archive_channel
description: Archives a channel. Members can still read history but nobody can post.

name: slack_upload_file
description: Uploads a file or text snippet to a channel.

name: get_billing_customer
description: Look up a billing customer by id or email: default payment method, account balance, tax ids and currency.

name: list_subscriptions
description: List subscriptions for a customer, or across all customers by status (active, past_due, trialing, canceled) or plan.

name: get_subscription
description: Get a subscription: plan, quantity, current period, trial end, discounts and next invoice date.

name: change_subscription_plan
description: Upgrade or downgrade a subscription to another plan. Prorates by default.

name: cancel_subscription
description: Cancel a subscription immediately or at the end of the current period.

name: pause_subscription
description: Pause collection on a subscription for a number of billing cycles.

name: list_invoices
description: List invoices for a customer or by status (draft, open, paid, void, uncollectible).

name: get_invoice
description: Get an invoice with line items, tax, amount due, amount paid and status.

name: void_invoice
description: Void an open invoice. A voided invoice cannot be paid or reopened.

name: send_invoice
description: Email an invoice to the customer's billing contacts, or re-send it.

name: create_credit_note
description: Issue a credit note against an invoice for part or all of its amount.

name: list_payments
description: List payments (charges) for a customer, including failed attempts with decline codes.

name: get_payment
description: Get one payment: amount, card brand and last4, outcome, risk score.

name: refund_payment
description: Refund a payment in full or in part to the original payment method.

name: retry_payment
description: Attempt collection on an open invoice now, using the customer's default payment method.

name: get_dunning_status
description: For a past_due subscription: retry schedule, attempts so far, last decline reason and reminder emails sent.

name: send_payment_method_update_link
description: Email the customer a hosted link where they can replace the card on file.

name: list_plans
description: Plans and prices in the product catalog.

name: apply_coupon
description: Apply a coupon or discount code to a customer or a subscription.

name: get_mrr_snapshot
description: Current MRR, active subscriber count and churn for the month, computed live from subscriptions.

name: list_services
description: Services managed by the deploy tool, with owning team and the version running in each environment.

name: get_service
description: One service: repo, runtime, environments, current release per environment, health summary.

name: list_deploys
description: Deploy history for a service and environment: version, who deployed, when and result.

name: get_deploy_status
description: Progress of an in-flight or finished deploy, step by step (build, migrate, rollout, verify).

name: trigger_deploy
description: Deploy a git ref to an environment. Production requires a green build of that ref.

name: rollback_deploy
description: Roll a service in an environment back to its previous release, or to a given version.

name: promote_release
description: Promote the release currently running in staging to production.

name: get_deploy_logs
description: Build and rollout logs for a single deploy.

name: tail_service_logs
description: Runtime logs from a service's running containers. Filter by level and text.

name: get_service_health
description: Health checks, error rate, p95 latency and instance status for a service.

name: restart_service
description: Rolling restart of every instance of a service.

name: scale_service
description: Set the number of instances (replicas) of a service.

name: list_env_vars
description: Environment variable names for a service; values are masked.

name: set_env_var
description: Create or update an environment variable. Restarts the service unless no_restart is set.

name: delete_env_var
description: Remove an environment variable from a service.

name: lock_environment
description: Freeze deploys to an environment, e.g. during an incident or a release freeze.

name: unlock_environment
description: Lift a deploy freeze.

name: list_feature_flags
description: Feature flags for a service and their state in each environment.

name: toggle_feature_flag
description: Turn a feature flag on or off, or set a percentage rollout, in one environment.
